name: zinput_di_enum_devices_callback_select_first_joystick
description: zInput::DI_EnumDevicesCallback_SelectFirstJoystick creates a DirectInput joystick device, queries IDirectInputDevice2A into the global joystick device, releases the temporary device, and stops enumeration on success.
known_limits: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x471f60 calls g_zInput_GlobalState->CreateDevice with instance->guidInstance, a local temporary device pointer, and null outer; create failure returns 1 to continue enumeration.

On create success, Binary Ninja calls the temporary device QueryInterface slot with IID_IDirectInputDevice2A and &g_zInput_JoystickDevice, releases the temporary device, and returns 0 to stop enumeration.

Native smoke zinput_joystick_init_device_smoke verifies the create-failure continue path directly, and verifies the success path through DI_InitJoystickDevice with QueryInterface, Release, downstream data-format/capability/cooperative-level setup, property application, acquisition, and initialized state.
No VC object-byte manifest covers 0x471f60 yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zInput joystick initialization pass.
